summary: Compatibility proof passes in full; the gate fails for this head on formatting only. The exact-base serialVersionUID was independently measured as -8705511030983987520 (the required value); the contributor head computes -7320877503891100753 and its streams are rejected by the base with InvalidClassException naming both values; the offered head restores the base UID and serializes compatibly in both directions with contents equal, including null keys and values. Named tests pass (SimpleOrderedMapTest 20/20, NamedListTest 5/5, seed 5334C0DE) and the overlaid test fails on the contributor head at exactly the UID assertion. But tidy reformats the branch's new SimpleOrderedMapTest.java (two line wraps, diff in evidence) and root check fails at :solr:solrj:spotlessJavaCheck on the same file, so under the gate's verdict policy this head cannot pass: a committed formatting successor and a fresh gate are required. The gate did not push the reformat on the implementation line's branch.
